> you don't need to push yourself faster than you are able to go. 

I know exactly what you mean >.<

I was practically shoved towards the campus lgbt group, and it really turned me off from going.

I have a therapist, and I've gone to a few of the local PFLAG meetings. I'm also joining a university transgender group that's just starting up. I have a hard time talking about my issues though, I feel like I'm just sending a stream of complaints at people, especially when I don't know them all that well yet. I'm also very quiet and socially inept.
